# US6 — interactive faction healer access display implementation plan

Issue: https://github.com/StanislavSmetaninSSM/The-Book-of-Eternity-Reborn/issues/1536
Baseline: 9868135d97a9dd8ea98c62d6a44ef9b14cfa7e52, remote verified, clean same
Linux checkout/branch. Sole writer/runner Sol; independent Astra/high DESIGN accepted,
Sol SOURCE/selection/PREP/OUTCOME required. Use superpowers:executing-plans inline.
Tracked scope: T135/T141/T143/T144–T147, FR075–085 and current service/role contract.

Goal: the existing no-argument console political inspection reaches a selected faction's
confirmed healers and readable public assistance terms; browser faction navigation shows
the same terms. Preserve the existing political/project information. A visible healer
with unknown/private/invalid terms stays visible without private text or an executable
service. This is access DISPLAY, not Shining treatment execution, negotiation, payment,
travel or a T142 lifecycle decision. The user authorized autonomous implementation;
the sole pending historical-faction rule is unchanged and does not block this view.

Architecture / alternatives

Extend the existing roster projection and political inspection, rather than add another
menu/registry/read service. Replacing the whole old inspection with the smaller direct
card would lose political/project information; a second healer browser would duplicate
visibility and source ownership. Keep the existing authoritative ReadCurrencyProfile
and paid admission unchanged; a narrow read-only sibling in AfterlifeHealingServiceContract
handles restricted PUBLIC declarations that the currency admission deliberately rejects.

- Add detached AfterlifeHealingServiceDisplayTerms(bool DeclaredAvailable,
  int? MinimumRelationship, int MultiplierPercent, IReadOnlyList<string> CompensationKinds,
  IReadOnlyList<string> AccessConditions) and ReadPublicDisplayTerms(WoundOwnerCoordinate,
  JsonObject profile). It returns DATA/null, never a quote, permission or mutation.
  Exact typed carrier/identity/realm/location, visible alive profile, integer HealingI–V,
  explicit closed service fields, public visibility, available/unavailable, null/integer
  relationship, integer 50–200 multiplier, existing six unique compensation kinds and
  nonempty string conditions. Do not invent a relationship range or reveal non-public terms.
- Extend internal ShiningFactionRosterEntry with private exact ResidentId and optional
  display terms. IDs are joins, never visible healer output. Reuse the already validated
  profile inside ProjectVisibleRoster: no second full materialization serialization.
  Shared role/tier/terms display lines use detached strings and read-only collections.
  Feather tariff rows use existing CalculatePrice only if explicitly declared, and only
  severity <= min(current Healing tier, IV), preserving the existing H>=W gate.
- Make ShowShiningFactionPoliticalInspectionPanel asynchronous. After PromptForFaction,
  reload the existing current context and uniquely resolve the same exact revealed faction.
  Pre-choice DATA is only a selection snapshot. Then read profiles once, project once,
  and join political fields against the fresh resident root by private exact ID, not name
  or array index. Preserve loyalty, restlessness, project and other political display.
  Missing/hidden/removed/ambiguous targets refuse stale output. Normal back/cancel is inert.
- Existing browser detail renders the same shared terms below each confirmed healer.
  Availability is the provider's declaration, not proven player access. Explicitly state
  that Shining command treatment is not yet connected; there is no active treatment button.

Optimization / integrity

Reuse existing parsed current roots and profile projection within one view operation.
After user selection, external mutation/reentry is possible, so earlier DATA cannot own
fresh visibility/affiliation/price. Reload once through the existing context, then share
profile DATA across members. Full identity is faction ID + ascension/affiliation/role +
exact typed actor ID/realm + profile visibility/life/materialization/arts/service values.
No cache or retained JsonNodes; exports are detached, new action reads fresh terms.
Actual source-open counters compare one/many members and changed terms. Keep all current
materialization and authority boundaries; display never authorizes a charge or heal.

Finite implementation / acceptance

- [x] Inspect canonical scope and existing callers; independent Astra DESIGN accepted with
  explicit compensation and tier/price constraints. T142 author question stays pending.
- [ ] Add one cheap causal typed actual no-argument console test:
  HealingAccessInteractiveInspectionShowsPublicRestrictedTermsWithoutMutation. Existing
  role/name is the control; missing public condition is semantic RED. New exact category
  shining-healer-access-causal, 60 s. Fresh Unit only (production unchanged), source/PDB
  proof, discovery, exact PlanOnly/PREP, one RED. No accepted 34/paid 80 repeat for scaffold.
- [ ] Implement the service display sibling, shared detached projection/formatter and
  fresh interactive join. Add independent typed negatives for private/malformed/foreign
  terms, declared availability/threshold, currencies versus noncurrency, rounding/tier
  limit, duplicates/same-name identity, immutable results and no admission broadening.
- [ ] Add real console/browser tests for public terms, inert return/cancel and selection
  races (hidden/removed faction, changed affiliation, hidden profile), literal rendering,
  one/many source counts and new-action changed terms. Reuse approved per-test fixtures,
  exact canonical snapshots and guarded cleanup; no whole-world/GameEngine preparation.
- [ ] Synchronize the existing GM rule/guide/matrix/main task/daemon directives, worked
  Shining access example/manifest and source guards. No new pending/control schema.
- [ ] Coherent SOURCE/impact-selection review, fresh affected Main/Support/Unit builds,
  exact catalog/PlanOnly/PREP, approved cheap causal/data/docs and UI checks, full captures
  and independent OUTCOME. Re-run old checks only when actually affected by changed
  projection/rendering; accepted paid 80 and HOLD DFR/Mortal/Windows are not substituted.
- [ ] Commit/push verified checkpoint, read remote SHA; no merge/force/history rewrite,
  branch deletion, new clone/restore or old raw/save/recovery deletion.

Resource / current boundary

Same environment available, no owned builds/tests at start, over 7 GiB free. Preserve
400 MiB build-start reserve plus full output, 128 MiB runtime floor and unbounded capture.
Raw stays outside checkout under /workspace/tboe-linux-evidence-20261025/us6-shining-healers.
Previous role gate 34/34 PASS and its complete capture are retained. The single causal Unit scaffold is now authored with its exact category/selection.
Production is unchanged; the new C# is UNCOMPILED, SOURCE/PREP and semantic RED pending. Global faction enforcement,
Shining service execution, universal Elyara travel, negotiated routes, DOM/provider/
fresh-process, DFR/Mortal/Windows and earlier guardian/cross-OS limitations remain open.

# US6 public Elyara treatment — design and implementation plan

2026-10-29. Issue: https://github.com/StanislavSmetaninSSM/The-Book-of-Eternity-Reborn/issues/1536
Baseline: b43e1bca68d6efd9248c4d0182fa224c562634d0.
Branch:1536-linux-qualification-20261025.
Same Linux checkout/branch, sole writer Sol. Existing T131–T140/T143–T147 own this
route; no new microtask/epic. Use executing-plans for inline implementation with
independent Sol SOURCE/selection/outcomes and Astra/high complex DESIGN review.

Functional qualification source:53c7dc2f4c14f78941f3cf3760d77902287225a1.
All80distinct targeted cases PASS; independent final OUTCOME accepted. Verify remote
SHA after publishing this final checkpoint; no new clone/restore is performed.
This is the first public, co-located Chaos Sea currency route, not all US6 or #1536.

Goal: a player currently co-located in the Chaos Sea with the alive canonical Elyara can see the
exact public Ink Feather quote, confirm it, receive the real healing result and
one safe world cycle/History, with exactly one charge for an accepted attempt
(including valid partial/failure), zero charge after cancellation/rejection/rollback,
and no repeated treatment/payment on replay. Shared console/browser paths are required.
This first complete paid route does not claim all Shining/negotiated services or
universal remote travel. Offers perform no travel; remote/inaccessible providers do
not become an executable treatment. Existing travel remains separate, one ordinary
cycle per accepted travel action. Universal destination binding remains open T143;
relocation/death must already invalidate this treatment route rather than be reset.
Relocated Shining state is preserved; Shining execution remains unavailable in this
Chaos Sea slice until its own route is supported.

Spec: FR077–082/FR086–088, data-model.md §14, contracts/afterlife-spiritual-wounds-
and-healing.md §§Elyara/service, existing retry payment identity. Prices are fixed:
base I/II/III/IV=25/50/100/200, integer multiplier50..200%, quote=ceil(base*percent/100).
Elyara uses100% and HealingV. No economic decision is missing; do not invent one.

Architecture and alternatives

- Chosen: new closed public-service family7 in the existing spiritual selection,
  request, resolver/continuation, accepted result and History path. It differs from
  private aid3–6 and never fabricates a prior free-aid participation grant. Existing
  arithmetic, GM weakened-graph rules, source guards and natural cycle apply unchanged.
- Payment uses canonical soul_state.inkFeathers via GuardianPolicyContracts policy
  and the existing common owner-companion after-image, sealed and published through
  existing C4 with wounds/effects/History/schedule. No UI subtraction, second write,
  reservation store, parallel payment registry or unified-resource Feather entry.
- A post-healing payment or repurposed private-aid receipt is rejected as an approach:
  it cannot prove atomic acceptance or the actual service gate/replay identity.

Concrete closed DATA and interfaces (not publication authority)

- Create Services/AfterlifeHealingServiceContract.cs: typed provider/service profile,
  quote input/quote and payment receipt. Strict profile keys follow §14; provider and
  patient use WoundOwnerCoordinate, locationRef is the canonical locationId (initial
  abode_system_elyara_001, not a second elyara_lazaret). Public currency route accepts
  explicit public/available profile, null minimumRelationship and empty accessConditions;
  nonempty/restricted conditions remain unavailable, never silently passed. Declared
  compensation kinds use the canonical set, while this route executes ink_feathers only.
- CalculatePrice(int severityRank,int multiplierPercent) rejects rank outside1..4 or
  percent outside50..200 and returns the exact upward integer price. Quote seals exact
  owners, wound fingerprint/rank, service/profile and life/location/access identity,
  Healing tier, compensation kind and amount. A quote is immutable DATA; it owns no
  permission or reserved funds. Wallet is checked freshly, not used as lasting authority.
- Add SpiritualServiceTreatmentSelection to existing SpiritualSelfTreatmentSelection
  as a mutually exclusive service branch (no aid/combat mix). Family7 request binds
  session/request/turn, exact quote, source fingerprint, attemptId and retained draw;
  repair/retry does not reroll. Use existing pending wound-command path, no new root.
- Create Services/AfterlifeHealingServicePlanner.cs to compose a typed payment from
  the original strict wallet into its complete common owner-companion Soul after-image
  BEFORE the plan seal. Reject insufficient funds before subtraction/clamping. Preserve
  total, including optional absence. Reject overlapping GM Feather changes explicitly;
  do not silently prune them. Result7 binds attempt+quote+exact wallet before/after.
  Assembly and physical C4 read-back must agree; a History amount alone proves nothing.
- Historical accepted result7 is authenticated replay DATA, never new permission:
  return its result without another debit or old-wallet restoration. New attempts
  reacquire all current service/wound/access/funds authority. C4 compensation and outer
  pre-turn rollback restore exact wallet+wound/effects/History/schedule together.
- Provider lifeState=alive|dead lives on the canonical afterlife actor profile, required
  for service eligibility; missing/invalid never means alive. Fresh seed may create
  alive; accepted dead→alive must reject, not be revived by upsert/normalization.
  Elyara ID guard_system_elyara_001, initial abode_system_elyara_001; fresh bootstrap
  includes her without replacing the player's selected active Guardian. Preserve
  accepted current realm/location/death. TierV/public100% invariants remain protected.

Execution steps (one functional route, not independent helper completion)

- [x] Finalize independent DESIGN of closed contracts, physical payment proof and
  life-state transition protection; resolve only real author-rule contradictions.
- [x] Add cheap independent quote/profile/payment RED fixtures (T131/T132/T133) and
  exact owning categories/selection: all price boundaries and ceil examples, malformed
  profiles/identities, insufficient funds, changed source/quote, no-mutation/replay,
  optional total preservation and immutable exports. Observe semantic RED before code.
- [x] Implement pure contract and minimal existing currency-policy composition;
  verify cheap GREEN and actual source read/computation counters before native Engine.
- [x] Wire family7 through existing admission→retained draw→continuation→common plan→
  C4 physical read-back→strict persisted History/replay, with real validated failed
  attempt charge and rollback controls. No blanket exemptions or source-guard removal.
- [x] Materialize protected Elyara service/life/profile fresh state and strict updates;
  add shared opaque provider/price choices and explicit confirmation to /лечить.
  Stale price/life/location/access/wound/capability/funds refuses before side effects.
- [x] Synchronize GM guide/registry/matrix/rules/main task, Elyara manifest/dossier,
  worked paid success/failure/rejection/rollback examples and exact source guards.
- [x] Complete coherent SOURCE/selection review, fresh affected builds, exact discovery/
  catalog/PlanOnly and addressable console/browser Engine scenarios. Preserve full
  raw/cleanup, distinguish control fixtures from live provider/fresh-process. Publish
  accepted checkpoint/remote SHA; keep remaining US6/travel/noncurrency/faction work open.

Review focus and causal acceptance

1. Price/service/provider or patient changes after display: no hidden replacement,
   fresh matching confirmation and prepublication checks. Pre-admission refusal draws
   nothing; post-draw rejection retains the sealed draw without reroll and no charge.
2. Duplicate/repair/cold replay: same attempt/draw and authenticated payment result,

        FileSystemManager.CanonicalWriteLease writeLease, StoryService.AcceptedStoryAppend? acceptedStoryAppend);
    private Task<List<ValidationIssue>> RunBorrowedPendingSnapshotValidationAsync(
        FileSystemManager.CanonicalWriteLease writeLease, Func<Task<List<ValidationIssue>>> validate);
    private Task<List<ValidationIssue>> RunPendingSnapshotValidationCoreAsync(
        Func<Task<List<ValidationIssue>>> validate, Func<FileSystemManager.PendingSnapshotValidationReadScope> beginRead);
    internal PendingSnapshotValidationReadScope BeginBorrowedPendingSnapshotValidationRead(CanonicalWriteLease writeLease);
    internal virtual MainAdmission? RetainedPhysicalAdmission => null;
    internal MainMutationReservation MainAdmission.BeginMutation();
    internal MainMutationReservation MainAccess.BeginMutation(MainAdmission admission, ValidationReadReservation? recoveryIssuance);

Последние две строки — объявления на указанных nested types, не синтаксис qualified method declaration. MainMutationReservation.Dispose снимает только свой зарегистрированный token. BeginPhysicalLeaseClose(MainAdmission) и BeginOwnerClosing(MainAdmission, Action markClosing) — внутренние MainAccess transitions под его _state; MainAdmission делегирует им с собственной identity. Имена допускают существующее style оформление, параметры/ordering и результат фиксированы.

## Plan3 — протокол владения и writers

1. Validate explicit lease у того же manager; reject inactive/foreign/metadata/finalization/replacement/worker capabilities. Для eligible console exact lease.MainAdmission должен быть live в текущей ancestry, а exact active AmbientRegistration — в ambient chain. HasAmbientCanonicalLease без сопоставления identity недостаточен. Никакого нового retain.
2. Под MainAccess._state установить reservation только если нет другого proof, sibling/foreign physical admission, active mutation, frozen/closing состояния. Единственный допустимый PhysicalScope — RetainedPhysicalAdmission этой reservation, реально зарегистрированный в access и ancestry. Owned World/spec4 без retained admission сохраняют прежний запрет всех existing physical borrowers.
3. Active mutation tokens и reservation взаимно исключаются тем же lock. Token охватывает mutation operation до первого recovery/preparation эффекта/awaited boundary и до конца publication/compensation/cleanup в finally. Locks не удерживаются через await. Existing per-path InProcessMutationRegistration не заменяется: он наблюдает paths и не покрывает все directory/recovery writers.
4. T240 начинает source audit по всему семейству partial FileSystemManager, затем составляет конечную таблицу same-lease write/append/conditional-write/delete/move/directory/image/worker-recovery/publication entrypoints → enclosing token или доказанный independent physical-admission conflict. Проверить raw physical mutation calls, а не только EnsureWorkerGeneralMutationAllowed. Известные пробелы: DeleteFileCore, DeleteOriginalDirectoryTree, DeleteTrustedLocalDirectoryTreeAsync/empty pruning, RecoverInterruptedWorkerApplyTransactionAsync, ранняя preparation PublishLocalImageFilesAsync/worker publication, прямой coordinated PublishLocalFilesAsync → PublishLocalCoreAsync и RecoverTrustedLocalStorage в .TrustedLocalStorage.cs. Для прямой publication envelope начинается до GetOrCreateSessionGeneration/EnsureDirectory/awaited hooks и заканчивается после publication/rollback/cleanup; вложенные shared envelopes снимают только свои tokens. Для обычного atomic write и move token начинается не позже существующей path registration, до обоих mutation hooks. Открытый обход блокирует production acceptance; изменение storage algorithms или файлов вне указанного filesystem guard scope требует отдельного решения.
5. Close transition и reserve используют тот же _state. Попытка закрыть lease при proof отказывает до изменения stream/parent/context/ambient fields; начатое закрытие исключает reservation. BeginClosing проверяет и ставит bound-closing атомарно; terminal freeze проверяет pending reservation до изменения frozen. MainAccess.Release сохраняет atomic check+mark/remove. Owned opening/closed cleanup exception допустим только для exact physical issuance; borrowed route его не получает.
6. Runner резервирует validator до reset caches, открывает scope, получает entry evidence, запускает прежний core с AcceptedStoryAppend, сверяет final physical evidence. В finally закрывает proof и shared admission, сохраняя primary/secondary ошибки. Borrowed teardown никогда не трогает ExternalPublicationContext.Dispose. После close проверяет сохранность оригинального lease/admission/ambient ownership; issues/logging возвращаются только после successful final proof и close.
7. Preexisting call — после его RefreshGameStateAsync и до ApplyTerminalResourceOutcomeAsync. Final call — после всех mutations/refresh и до обработки issues, restoration, AllowCleanup/cleanup. Когда allowPreexistingStateIssues=true, это две свежие invocation через промежуточные записи. Оригинальный caller владеет lease до своего finally.

# CRASH5 — Implementation Plan, редакция 2: одна операция проверки исходного снимка

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: `superpowers:executing-plans`. Один разработчик выполняет canonical [tasks.md](tasks.md), T230…T237; отдельный reviewer проверяет законченный блок. Этот план дополняет plan1 ниже, а не переоценивает его результаты.

**Goal:** убрать повторную полную аутентификацию исходного pending snapshot внутри одного console post-materialization `ValidateGameStateAsync`, сохранив реальные проверки текущего состояния и отказ при утрате исходного доказательства.
**Architecture:** отдельный typed invocation получает существующий canonical read-quiescence lease, исключает участвующие записи и совместное использование validator, аутентифицирует снимок на входе и физически сверяет исходные зависимости перед возвратом результата. Каждая repair iteration создаёт новое доказательство. Browser original optimization и обычные validation entrypoints сохраняются.
**Tech Stack:** существующие C#/.NET 8, SDK10, PowerShell7/xUnit; новых packages, save schemas или GM-контрактов нет.
**Spec:** [редакция4](spec.md), одобрена из `da3efec34a6407260e7a9c19830f354740cccce2`; [issue1536](https://github.com/StanislavSmetaninSSM/The-Book-of-Eternity-Reborn/issues/1536). Ветка `1536-crash5-linux-windows-spec-20261019`, planning base `fa0a53001502b8ee1c5067f7fc1b529d683f67df`.
**Status:** владелец одобрил точный plan2 из `bd9c8dd43430ce4d7c4852c580a76c012fed204b` ответом «да». Исполняются T230–T237; Windows5 пока FAIL_INCOMPLETE, Linux UNRUN. Новые результаты будут привязаны к своим SHA.

## Plan2 — границы, доказательство и численные критерии

- Сохраняются все spec3/game oracles, cut0…4, producer73/resumer0, 220s/10s/10s/15m, source42 probe5m; NativeLineage/C protocol не меняются. Никаких collector, нового bypass или неизменённых повторных прогонов.
- Lifetime — ровно вызов проверки game state в `ValidateCurrentGameStateOrShowErrorsAsync`, после `EnsureClientOwnedSystemFilesHealthyAsync`, до последующих narrative/interface checks и любой repair/publication/refresh/cleanup. Только `PostAcceptedMaterializedStateValidationSource` в console; не весь repair-loop, не весь turn. Для новой итерации lifetime начинается заново.
- Существующая физическая блокировка исключает участвующих writers. Её purpose `PublicationReadQuiescence` сам по себе не означает запрет записи: отдельная reservation должна блокировать повторное acquisition, same-lease mutation, lifecycle/owner close и чужой доступ. Recovery остаётся в прежнем порядке при opening, до замораживания источника. Нельзя выдавать console за browser.
- Успех означает: entry evidence действовало при чтении и все удержанные зависимости совпали с ним до возврата результата. Изменённые/удалённые bytes, включая изменения с прежним mtime, другая полностью согласованная manifest/authority пара и появление ранее отсутствовавшего request alternative дают отказ. Проверяется точное entry evidence, а не просто валидность нового снимка на выходе. Ошибка final proof или освобождения запрещает успешный результат.
- Конституция исключает намеренные внешние гонки с открытым сохранением. Две проверки не обнаруживают произвольную raw edit→restore, полностью произошедшую между ними; такого обещания здесь нет. Все участвующие изменения во время lifetime запрещены. Durable raw changes, внесённые тестовым hook между consumers, должны быть отвергнуты до принятия результата. Если review требует next-consumer detection даже для временно изменённых и восстановленных raw bytes, этот дизайн нельзя принимать: сохранить прежний физический путь и вернуться к scope decision, не ослаблять spec автоматически.
- Алгоритм: **не более 2 полных аутентификаций исходного снимка на успешную invocation**, независимо от числа потребителей. В отдельной причинной fixture с R=3 rollback paths, различными snapshot/rollback paths и N=1/8/32 повторными sync+async lookup — **не более 6 физических rollback callback reads** после acquisition и до final proof включительно; контекст, ошибки и ordered issues совпадают с обычным путём. До GREEN предел не меняется.
- Отдельно учитывать всю операцию: clean warm admission добавляет cohort scan R, cold admission — ещё full authority R. Для той же fixture, без recovery/самостоятельных leaf reads этих путей, **warm ≤3R=9, cold ≤4R=12**; marker/control reads отдельно. Cohort scan использует другой reader и не попадает в прежний ordinary callback counter: подтвердить весь бюджет отдельным узким test seam в существующем physical leaf. До измерения статус UNMEASURED и T230/T231 не приняты; нельзя объявлять 6 полным I/O. В actual source42 хранить общий trace; дополнительные игровые source/current reads нельзя вычитать или выдавать за нарушение/соблюдение component bound.
- Никакого process-wide cache, mtime-only authority или сохранения источника между invocations. Current game files читаются физически. Кэшируем только результат аутентификации исходного manifest; existing snapshot leaf readers и их hash/error semantics остаются. Private entry manifest не выдаётся mutable: lookup получает отдельную DTO-копию из неизменного entry serialization.

## Plan2 — протокол invocation

1. Синхронно зарезервировать validator до сброса общих кэшей. Новый entrypoint допускается только вне browser-original, при отсутствии старого override/same-turn retained inputs. Неeligible caller продолжает прежний обычный путь до создания scope; ошибка после начала reservation не включает fallback.
2. Синхронный filesystem issuer на том же flow устанавливает ambient registration и удерживает original MainAccess reservation. Pending/failed opening закрывает только собственные регистрации. Существующая read-quiescence acquisition завершает штатный recovery; затем scope становится read-only. Не использовать async factory, которая возвращает lease после потери caller AsyncLocal.
3. Зафиксировать manager/root/owner, actual generation, manifest bytes, authority bytes и все три request alternatives с exact absence. Выполнить исходную reader authentication через retained lease, собрав actual rollback bytes без повторного чтения. Missing/Unusable сохраняют прежний статус/ошибки; не становятся Usable и не являются поводом бесконечного retry.
4. Внутри одного admitted `ValidateGameState` scoped sync/async lookup проверяет текущие reservation/owner/lease/generation и отдаёт копию исходного DTO. Доступ другого validator invocation, закрытого/copied контекста или scope replacement отказывает. Current file и snapshot leaf reads сохраняют физический путь.
5. До возврата issues физически перечитать manifest/authority/request alternatives/generation и original rollback dependency set через тот же lease, выполнить fresh physical lookup и сравнить с entry evidence. Self-consistent replacement тоже отказывает. Сверить bytes, реально прочитанные checker, с entry bytes; не запускать отдельный третий rollback scan ради сравнения.
6. Final proof, закрытие lease и reservation происходят до успеха. При exception/cancellation — cleanup в finally; original failure остаётся primary, teardown failure сохраняется secondary. Любой invalidated/closed scope необратим. После возврата ремонта, нормализации, публикации, refresh и очистки удержанного source нет.

## CRASH5 — внутренние interfaces и решения

### A. Finite pipe owner (US1, L1…L7/L9)

Новый вход: `internal static Task<NativeLineageOwner> StartFinitePipeAsync(ProcessStartInfo startInfo, string packageDirectory, Action<NativeLineageOwner, int> observeHeldRoot, CancellationToken cancellationToken)`; `internal string BootstrapDirectory { get; }` для явного учёта private root. `packageDirectory` абсолютен и проходит существующий `GmWorkerNativePackage.Validate`; executable абсолютен, shell отключён, ArgumentList сохранён. Pre-cancel/validation отклоняют до создания owner.

Добавить immutable finite flag к owner constructor, default false; только новый вход выставляет true. Копирование Environment происходит при terminal **или finite**; worker-host default не меняется. Для pipe ветки выделить реально используемый pure builder `internal static ProcessStartInfo CreatePipeSupervisorStartInfo(ProcessStartInfo host, string executable, string runId, string socketPath, bool finitePipe)` в этом же файле: прежние100/2500/host-v2/ArgumentList, shell=false, redirects/WorkingDirectory; только finite копирует host.Environment. Terminal ветка остаётся прежней. Выделить `internal static Task<string> ReadPipeOutputAsync(Stream input, bool finitePipe)`: прежний UTF8 reader/leaveOpen, finite ReadToEndAsync, false — существующий bridge capture с cap. `CaptureHostOutputAsync` вызывает этот helper внутри своего прежнего catch/Lose. Оба читателя работают с создания pipes; status отдельно. Это используемые production seams для локального поведенческого RED, не копии алгоритма в тестах.

`StartAsync` сохраняет текущую B2-передачу pidfd и peer validation. Существующий held-root callback вызывается до A2; новый вход оборачивает его как `pid => observeHeldRoot(owner, pid)`, чтобы adapter действительно получил original owner до возврата StartFinitePipeAsync. Adapter idempotently регистрирует owner/root evidence и независимо читает `/proc/<pid>/stat` field22 плюс StartTime UTC. Callback не делает async work/build/fixture creation. A2 отправляется один раз, внутри прежнего 5s bootstrap; native startup входит в исходный 220s deadline.

Чистые internal types в `NativeLineageOwner.cs`:

```csharp
internal enum NativeFiniteStartDecision { Pending, Started, Completed, Rejected }
internal sealed record NativeFiniteObservation(bool Released, bool Started,
    bool RootExited, bool SupervisorExited, int? SupervisorExitCode,
    bool StatusCompleted, bool HelperErrorCompleted,
    GmWorkerStopEvidence? Terminal, string? Uncertainty);
internal static NativeFiniteStartDecision EvaluateFiniteStart(NativeFiniteObservation observation);
internal static bool CanAcceptFiniteClosedControl(NativeFiniteObservation observation, bool controlSettled = true);
internal static Task<NativeFiniteStartDecision> AwaitFiniteStartAsync(
    Func<NativeFiniteObservation> snapshot, Task started, Task retirementObserved,
    Task<string> authorityLost, CancellationToken cancellationToken);
```

Static methods являются членами NativeLineageOwner; enum/record — internal типы этого же файла. Predicates/await helper только оценивают наблюдения, не создают положительные evidence. Production snapshot получает Terminal исключительно из существующего проверяющего parser/run binding, exit — от исходных owner/pidfd, не от JSON child. retirementObserved завершается после accepted terminal и завершения original root/supervisor/status/helper-error; fault тоже будит await. Unit-crafted records проверяют policy, не квалифицируют запуск. Отдельный async unit test подаёт навсегда pending started и завершённый retirementObserved: он проверяет именно используемое production ожидание, без подавления/подделки status frames.

Evaluate: установленный Uncertainty/terminal Uncertain, подтверждённый failed helper или exec failure через проверенный status → Rejected. Неизвестный исход exec, в частности после A2 без Started/terminal, остаётся Pending до нового события/deadline; отсутствие evidence не объявляется exec failure. До A2 → Pending; подтверждённый Started без uncertainty → Started; после A2 допустим Completed без Started только с positive root exit, accepted scoped terminal (nonnull RootExitCode, CleanupComplete=true, AuthorityRetained=false), supervisor0, законченными status/helper-error. Иначе Pending до deadline. Отдельного выдуманного поля exec error нет: failure приходит через existing status/Uncertainty. Expected73/0 проверяет game adapter, не общая finite policy. Новое finite ожидание выбирает Started/terminal/authority-loss; прежние entrypoints продолжают ждать Started+EnsureLive.

Stop finite-only: если root уже вышел, дождаться автоматического scoped retirement вместо лишнего S. Если S нужен, сохранить ошибку записи до получения исходных terminal/exit observations; признать закрытый control ожидаемым можно только при `CanAcceptFiniteClosedControl=true`: полное положительное естественное завершение с reason `root-exited`, root exit, supervisor0, законченными status/helper-error и отсутствием uncertainty. Иначе сохранить `control-lost`; никогда не очищать установленный Uncertain. Не подавлять malformed/lost status, exec-failed, owner-lost и timeout. Старый stop branch не меняется.

После root wait (оставшийся 220s) adapter всегда делает stop/join≤10s и output settlement≤10s; native внутренние 5s/5s остаются. Полный путь успеха: root73/0 + owner terminal + supervisor0 + оба EOF + Dispose. Raw streams сохранить до успешной очистки. На partial start использовать `GmWorkerOwnedLaunchException.Owner` даже без root PID.

### B. Общая fixture / Windows (US2, W1…W4)

В `JointInterfaceCrashProcessSupport`:

```csharp
internal enum JointInterfaceCrashBackend { NativeLinux, DirectLinux, DirectWindows }
internal sealed record JointInterfaceCrashMode(int Cut, bool Diagnostic, string? Fault);
internal static JointInterfaceCrashBackend SelectBackend(bool windows, bool linux, JointInterfaceCrashMode mode);
internal static JointInterfaceCrashMode ReadAndValidateEntryMode(string own, int cut, bool windows, bool linux);
internal sealed record JointInterfaceCrashIdentity(int Pid, DateTime BirthUtc,
    string BirthKind, ulong? LinuxBirthTick, long? WindowsStartTimeUtcTicks);
internal static ProcessStartInfo CreateChildStartInfo(string dotnetRoot, string[] arguments, string own, bool windows);
internal static JointInterfaceCrashIdentity ReadLiveIdentity(int pid, Process? originalWindowsProcess);
```

Windows требует корректный parent.json с явно заданными Diagnostic=false, Fault=null и совпадающим Cut0…4. Общий helper и **обе** public child функции вызывают validation перед созданием fixture; missing/invalid mode отклоняется. Linux integrity/diagnostic остаются допустимыми на старом пути. Неподдерживаемая OS — явная ошибка.

Linux BirthTick сохраняется field22/ulong; Windows — положительные StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks/long, родитель читает original Process, child себя. В common outcome BirthKind явен. Cut/resume JSON Linux сохраняют существующий BirthTick и прежний diagnostic format; Windows добавляет `BirthKind=windows-process-start-utc-ticks` и `WindowsStartTimeUtcTicks`, не записывает Windows ticks в BirthTick. `WoundConsequenceEnvelopeTests.IndependentEffects_ArePreservedAndNeverConsumeSlotsOrEnterProfileValidation`
сохраняет синтетический независимый payload при проверке envelope; реальный
producer, runtime carrier и переживание лечения этим не доказаны. Названный в
T148 `SarefMemorySuppressionWoundIsolationTests.cs` отсутствует. Это основание

**Какие новые данные могли бы изменить L01 blocker — без получения их сейчас:**

  bound. Повторяющийся stack не доказывает отсутствие прогресса, sampled thread
  time не равен on-CPU времени.
  [DiagnosticsClient](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/diagnostics/diagnostics-client-library)
  поддерживает EventPipe; [актуальная документация dotnet-trace](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/diagnostics/dotnet-trace)
  уточняет семантику thread sampling. Версию/providers/decoder/symbols/формат
  нужно закрепить до будущего SOURCE/PREP.
- По чтению PATH и трёх перечисленных tool roots сейчас не найдены `dotnet-trace`,

  текущим поручением не допускаются. Отсутствие вне проверенных roots не заявляется.
- [dotnet-stack](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/diagnostics/dotnet-stack)
  может дать managed stacks, но здесь не найден. `createdump` не заменяет
  анализатор; dump требует отдельной проверки ptrace/диска/паузы target и matching

  не предлагается.

### Established contract and field ownership

`contracts/wound-materialization-command.md:22–39` assigns the owning producer the
sealed owner/realm/domain/event, legal location profile and maximum severity, with
real finalized typed source resolution. FR-004/005 preserve GM choice inside, and
client enforcement of, that envelope. FR-007 and the contract explicitly permit an
upstream typed narrative injury's causal declaration; this is distinct from QTE's
resource `source.kind=narrative_outcome`, which proves no narrative injury by itself.
No cross-setting HP-to-severity formula or anatomy/wound catalogue is required.
The approved Superpowers design's `Wound Opportunity and GM Authority` and
`Mortal Wound Construction` sections explicitly assign the producer-sealed maximum
and exclude a cross-setting damage formula; accepted decision8 fixes Mortal I–IV.

The compatible internal contract already exists in
`MortalWoundOccurrenceProducer.cs:469–481` (`MortalWoundAcceptedHarmResult`) and
`data-model.md:1911–1938`; the first owner must project these fields rather than
invent a parallel opportunity or public authority surface:

| Existing field/concept | Owner, provenance and bound |
| --- | --- |
| `Owner`, `Domain`, `Source`, candidate/event ordinals | Client producer derives the exact accepted player/physical source and selected command from genuine source context; complete ordered events and batch coordinates remain mandatory. Identities, replay key, fingerprints and seals are client-derived. |
| `ProfileKey` | Producer-owned exact causal-profile identifier, not an anatomy, material/body or consequence-profile catalogue. The exact identifier/naming is an engineering choice tied to the real resolver. |
| `SafeContext.Target`, `Cause`, `AllowedLocationKinds` | The source owner accepts and freezes bounded causal/readable context and the legal unique nonempty subset of `anatomical|systemic|mental|spiritual_axis|other`; later correlation cannot broaden it. This generic five-kind vocabulary does not itself prescribe a physical-source subset. |
| `Outcome.Kind`, `MaximumSeverityRank`, `ReadableCause` | Explicit accepted typed harmful result with maximum1–4. The real source owner supplies the maximum; positive health damage alone never derives it, and there is no default outcome maximumIV. An empty accepted harm list is harmless. |
| `HardMaximumSeverityRank` | Existing global Mortal I–IV bound permits4 when no narrower source restriction applies. It is separate from the event maximum. Existing `WoundOpportunityAuthority.cs:308–312` computes `min(outcome maximum, hard maximum)`. No new source cap rule is introduced. |
| `MinimumSeverityRank`, `GuaranteedTrigger`, `WorseningTarget` | Ordinary create uses null minimum/guarantee and no worsening target. This first slice adds no guarantees or inferred worsening; wider T070 remains open. |
| Actual wound location/name/severity | GM authors the actual wound and chooses none or I through the effective maximum. `classification.locationProfile` is separate from causal `ProfileKey`; its kind must belong to the sealed source set (`WoundResponseInputComposer.Parsing.cs:234–247`). Optional exact body-part coordinates are not a required body/material profile. |
| Consequence profiles | Separate closed effect language and severity budgets, `data-model.md:1426–1462`; they constrain the created wound's mechanics, not the source maximum. |

### Exact first-slice serialization proposal

This is an implementation of the approved internal authority model, not a new damage
formula or policy permission request. Review this precise proposal before source edits.

| Surface | Closed first-slice contract |
| --- | --- |
| `QteTerminalOutcome.physicalInjury` | Optional; absence preserves existing resource-only QTE. When present, exactly `schemaVersion`=1, `resourceCommandOrdinal` (one-based index into that outcome's existing `responseFragment.resourceChanges`), `maximumSeverityRank` (integer1–4), `cause` (trimmed nonempty readable text, at most2000 characters, no controls), `allowedLocationKinds` (unique1–5 exact existing location tokens). No defaults, explicit null, unknown/duplicate/case-confusable fields, foreign source IDs, owner, profile, hard cap, guarantee, worsening or caller seals. |
| Client `TurnRequest.woundOpportunities` | Empty or one safe offer for the first pending ordinary QTE/player occurrence in existing canonical occurrence order. Row is exactly `opportunityRef`, `domain`=`physical`, `maximumSeverity` (I–IV), `safeContext` with `target`, `cause`, `allowedLocationKinds`. No internal owner IDs, paths, source context, fingerprints or occurrence identity. Remaining rows stay pending; full source batch/event checks are not truncated. |
| GM `output/mortal_wound_decisions.json` | One existing decision object, without a new wrapper: `{opportunityRef, decision:"none"}` or `{opportunityRef, decision:"materialize", woundRef, proposal}` using the existing strict Mortal proposal grammar. No binding/source correlation/maxima/authority/receipt/after-image fields. When one safe row is offered, exactly its ref is required; stale/foreign/missing/multiple decisions reject. With an empty projection the old ordinary/QTE behavior remains, no file is required, and an unsolicited file rejects. |

All numeric and string tokens use strict raw JSON validation before deserialization
or `JsonNode` conversion. `resourceCommandOrdinal` must index the actual outcome array,
not merely be below a constant; the existing resource mutation bound512 remains
(`ResourceMaterializationContract.MaxMutationsBeforeTriggers`). Complete accepted
wound-event authority retains its existing1–160 bound; an over-limit vector rejects

health definition/instance; a declaration targeting stamina/energy rejects before

source result, not a guarantee: no applied health harm means no occurrence.

The decision file is GM-owned transient input, not canonical authority. Its response

agreement; do not re-distribute a general `GameResponse`. Add it to ordinary transient

### First real owner and ordered implementation design

QTE remains the smallest traced real terminal owner: ordinary validated offer →
preselection freeze → exact selected chapter/action/grade/outcome → finalized resource
and effect result. Combat/narrative source labels (`ResourceAcceptedTurnInputComposer`)
and formal/hazard effect presence provide no more complete typed physical result;
changing the adapter token would not supply a real producer. Seven supported adapter
kinds still have zero production implementations.

1. **Accept the source envelope before selection.** Use the existing
   `ValidationService.PlayerAndInventory.cs` QTE offer/terminal validator,
   `QteSceneService.QteTerminalOutcome:6460` and
   `QteDeferredEffectContinuation.CaptureAsync`. The closed declaration above maps only
   the established source semantics, binds the exact existing terminal resource
   command, and participates in ordinary admission and the offer freeze before play
   (`GameEngine.TurnLifecycle.cs:2224`, `QteSceneService.cs:635,692–750`). Existing
   resource-only QTE with no physical declaration continues without a physical
   opportunity. A malformed injury-enabled declaration rejects before admission/freeze;
   raw prose, a resource source-kind label or a self-consistent caller seal is insufficient.
2. **Retain genuine source-N authority.** The continuation already seals
   `input/turn_request.json` bytes/hash (`QteDeferredEffectContinuation.cs:95,931–943`),
   session/generation/turn and source roots. Raw retained request bytes are not a
   validated request/snapshot projection: `TurnRequest` has no snapshot token and
   `QteDeferredAcceptedMechanicsPlanner.cs:721` uses continuation-derived coordinates
   and empty events. Project the genuine accepted source session/request/snapshot/turn
   and complete ordered events into the existing common input; derive source identity,
   key and seals internally. Capture an immutable source projection while the original
   validated context and signed files are still live, before accepted-turn snapshot
   cleanup. `HandleAcceptedQteOfferAsync(response, snapshotContext)` already runs with
   that genuine held context before terminal cleanup: pass its validated detached
   authority explicitly into QTE acceptance/capture rather than reconstructing it from
   raw request JSON. Cover normal, recovered and late-ready
   `HandleAcceptedQteOfferAsync` paths; retaining a context that lazily reads deleted
   files is insufficient. Do not manufacture an original binding from terminal IDs.
3. **Project only the finalized selected harm.** Wire a real registered
   `IMortalWoundOccurrenceProducerDraft.Project` to the selected QTE result after the
   common resource/effect boundary is complete (`ReduceRegistered:66–113`). Resolve

## Scoped recovery publication plan — approved revision1, 2026-09-29 (#1536)

Implements [MORTAL-RECOVERY-PUBLICATION](./spec.md#MORTAL-RECOVERY-PUBLICATION)
under T081-D-PERFORMANCE-RUNTIME-UNBLOCK, not the remaining feature. Use
Superpowers executing-plans/TDD/debugging; mandatory final independent Astra
XHigh review. Keep original test selections and Fast7/PreMerge30 ceilings.
No commit, push, merge or issue closure. Optional Spec Kit commit/context hooks
are skipped under the owner's existing bounded-execution instructions.

**Architecture and constitution gate:** C#/.NET8, existing file-backed canonical
state, registry-owned wound/effect stages and common publication. Recovery owns
no second writer, reservation, skill projection or fake create opportunity.
The private continuation retains accepted-state identity, original binding,
complete source baselines and detached ordered resolution. Registry admission
recomputes the whole result before issuing it. History stores comparison/replay
evidence, never a replacement live publication capability. Traceability,
test-first, state authority and GM synchronization gates pass with this design.

## Summary

Replace the loose pre-alpha wound arrays with one strict, setting-agnostic wound
identity/lifecycle kernel and two setting adapters. Mortal wounds retain free GM
construction and world-specific diagnosis/treatment without a wound catalog. Spiritual
wounds attach to bounded afterlife strain opportunities, add standard resilience and
healing arts, and recover through combat treatment, safe world cycles, providers, or
natural entity progression.

The implementation extends the existing accepted-mechanics transaction rather than
adding an independent writer. A staged
`WoundAcceptedTurnPlanner.Prepare -> EffectAcceptedTurnPlanner ->
WoundAcceptedTurnPlanner.Finalize` handshake resolves wound/effect source ownership;
the wound persists a bounded complete source-definition graph separately from the
directly materialized root effect bindings, while later `apply_definition` descendants
remain effect-runtime identities resolved through an indexed exact wound source;
the prepare stage emits only typed root application refs, the effect planner remains the
sole allocator of opaque permanent effect IDs and returns the exact result map with
actual component counts and domain/versioned materialization fingerprints derived from
the created roots and consumed by finalization;
the exported wound source is non-materializable to ordinary GM effect commands and the
sealed typed batch is the only direct-root authority;
each root receives a unique derived creation event while retaining the accepted wound
event as separate causal chronology, and non-interchangeable stage seals culminate in an
internally computed/revalidated common prepared-plan fingerprint;
the common plan then publishes wound carriers, identity/history, linked effects,
resources/items, scheduler outcomes, provider payment, journals, and player output
under one snapshot/write-lease/rollback boundary. Console and browser use one
visibility-safe application/projection service for `/раны` and `/лечить` workflows.

Mortal opportunity ingress uses a signed accepted-occurrence boundary rather than
trusting source-shaped JSON. One closed pending occurrence language covers formal, QTE,
combat, trap, check, hazard, and narrative producers; the active pending-turn snapshot
binds its exact bytes. Initial composition and validation independently reconstruct the
complete ordered accepted-event set, and the common plan atomically appends one durable
opportunity-decision receipt for both `none` and `materialize` while consuming the
pending occurrence. This closes cold replay without adding a second writer.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: C#/.NET 8 (`net8.0`, nullable enabled); TypeScript 6.0 and React
19.2 for browser surfaces; PowerShell 7 for bounded verification and daemon entrypoints.

**Primary Dependencies**: ASP.NET Core local/loopback host; Spectre.Console 0.49.1;
FluentValidation 11.9; existing accepted-mechanics, effect materialization, resource,
Mortal item/location/actor, afterlife profile/conflict/progression, Guardian, and
Shining Abode services; React/Vite 8/Vitest for browser presentation.

**Storage**: Local file-backed strict JSON below `game_state/`, with client-owned
identity/history/command/pending roots, exact before-images, atomic file writes, pending
turn snapshots, and whole-turn rollback. No database or remote service.

**Testing**: xUnit 2.9 unit/integration projects through
`pwsh .\scripts\test-csharp.ps1`; Roslyn/source/documentation guards; Vitest and compiled
player-facing tests through `npm run verify`; rendered interaction/privacy checks with
the project-preferred browser skill when browser UI changes.

**Target Platform**: Local Windows game client and PowerShell 7 daemon, console client,
and loopback desktop/mobile-responsive browser client. No cloud dependency or telemetry.

**Project Type**: Multi-surface local game client/runtime with C# console/host,
file-backed canonical state, GM bridge/daemon prompts, and React browser frontend.

**Performance Goals**: One indexed catalog pass per root and near-linear planning in
the number of wound/effect/resource operations; no wound-by-effect nested scans; bounded
repair/pending waves; ordinary wound query/choice response comparable to existing
effects/status commands; no new unbounded test lane. Version-1 limits are 2,000 active
wounds, 20,000 history rows, 20,000 opportunity-decision receipts, 128 commands, 64
repair candidates, 32 pending Mortal occurrences with 1-160 accepted events each, 32
routes/diagnosis paths per wound, 16 requirements per route/path, 16 known-fact
prerequisites and 16 reveals per diagnosis path, 16 complications, four consequences,
and 32 wound transitions per accepted turn. Wound source indexing separately caps five definitions
and five root bindings per wound, 10,000 of either across 2,000 pre-turn active wounds,
at most 10,000 active/suspended wound-owned effect instances, and 160
definitions/root applications across 32 same-turn transitions; generic
non-wound source limits remain independent. The five-definition bound charges a slot to
the reaction producer and each flattened non-marker leaf component. Selective
complication cleanup builds one first-create causal parent index, visits each parsed
source-group identity at most once, reconstructs `base_wound | complicationId` root
domains, and rejects cyclic, ambiguous, foreign, or cross-domain lineage before
mutation; replacement succession is non-ownership lifecycle evidence.

**Constraints**: Direct pre-alpha cutover with no migration, legacy reader, dual write,
or fallback; no wound catalog; no automatic ordinary wound or soul dissipation; exact
ordinal/confusable authority; one new spiritual wound per side/conflict; eight
first-class persistent spiritual wound effect profiles, never combat-condition aliases;
effect removal cannot heal; one complete accepted transaction and snapshot rollback;
one safe-cycle healing attempt per wound/cycle; console/browser semantic parity;
Russian in-world copy; recursive privacy and renderer escaping; afterlife
docs/examples/registry synchronized.

**Scale/Scope**: One common kernel; Mortal and afterlife adapters; player, named NPC,
combatant, player soul, Guardian, resident, radiant/afterlife actor owners; wound
creation through terminal History; linked effects/resources/items/scheduler; spiritual
conflict/art/progression/providers; console/browser commands; GM rules, daemon prompts,
guides, examples, manifests, and source guards. Implementation is expected to span many
source/test/doc files but one accepted Spec Kit feature and issue.

**Source Issue(s)**: [#1536](https://github.com/StanislavSmetaninSSM/The-Book-of-Eternity-Reborn/issues/1536),
depends on completed [#1535](https://github.com/StanislavSmetaninSSM/The-Book-of-Eternity-Reborn/issues/1535);
related #1500, #1511, #1512, #1516, #1517, #1518. Create a separate linked issue if the

validation, normalizer, pending/control and rollback; effects/resources/items;

**Structure Decision**: Keep one C# runtime/application layer and extend its existing
partial services rather than add projects or repositories. New wound classes own the
strict domain and staged planner. Existing effect/resource/owner/snapshot/profile/
conflict services remain their domain authorities and receive narrow typed integration
points. Active state stays in owner-appropriate carriers; a small global wound index and
append-only history provide identity/replay agreement. Console/browser are adapters to
one shared projection/action service. GM capability changes always update rules, daemon
entrypoints, guides, examples, manifests, and guards in the same slice.

## Architecture and execution order

```text
sealed event / player command / scheduler cycle
                    │
                    ▼
        owner + wound opportunity authority
                    │
                    ▼
      Wound planner Prepare (no canonical writes)
          │ wound ID + complete source graph + typed root refs
          │ + expected component counts/materialization fingerprints (no effect IDs)
          ▼
        Effect accepted-turn planner
          │ opaque root IDs + actual recomputed counts/fingerprints
          │ + exact application result map/after-images
          ▼
      Wound planner Finalize (root links/graph/budgets/exact materialization agreement)
          │ wound transitions + resource/item/scheduler intents
          ▼
         AcceptedMechanicsPlanner
          │ trusted common prepared-plan fingerprint / before-images / after-images
          ▼
 validated handoff + canonical write lease + snapshot rollback
          │
          ▼
  wound/effect/resource/profile/schedule/history/output commit
```

Same-root changes are typed and composed once. In particular,
`afterlife_entity_profiles.json` may receive art progression, wound, effect, and service
state in one accepted turn; independent whole-root producers are rejected.

## Implementation phases

### Phase 0 — Research and design closure

Complete and commit the approved design, feature spec, research decisions, data model,
contracts, quickstart, tasks, and cross-artifact analysis. Reconcile direct code
inspection with read-only Mortal, afterlife, and accepted-mechanics research reports.
No production code is edited in this phase.

### Phase 1 — Common kernel and transactional authority

1. Add RED strict parser/bounds/legacy rejection tests.
2. Implement the version-1 wound envelope, owner coordinate, identity index, append-only
   history, carrier catalog, transition reducer, and agreement checks.
3. Add RED opportunity/source/guarantee and consequence budget/power tests.
4. Persist the strict bounded wound-owned source graph and separate root bindings, then
   implement staged prepare/finalize planning, an immutable typed wound-effect operation
   batch, accepted wound source export, a shared domain/versioned materialization-
   fingerprint writer, effect-owned opaque root allocation, and exact
   `applicationRef -> effectId` results with actual component counts/fingerprints.
   Prepare, effect planning, and Finalize independently derive or recompute the exact
   source/component agreement from detached payloads. Do not preallocate any effect ID
   in the wound planner; reaction-only descendants have no application ref or reserved
   identity.
   Treat prepared slot ordinals as correlations, then canonically renumber the accepted
   result slots per wound batch after random opaque IDs exist (`effectId` ordinal,
   prepared within-root semantic order, contiguous `1..N`); Finalize independently
   recomputes that mapping before persistence.
   Carry reducer/history-only transition facts through an internal immutable authority
   record with a separate seal bound to the prepared input and local/permanent wound
   identities, so zero-operation wounds retain exact provenance without changing the
   public source-export or preparation fingerprint format.
   Preserve pre-turn wound carriers, identity, and history through a second detached
   internal authority record whose seal binds their fixed-order canonical bytes to the
   prepared input, so Finalize can derive honest collection and history after-images
   without recovering state from an irreversible fingerprint.
   Require the same-turn wound source-authority set to equal the prepared exports
   exactly, reserve every accepted event reference against derived wound operation
   events before allocation, and freeze/detach returned predicate evidence.
   During Finalize, independently require the exact reciprocal prepared-root effect set
   in active effects, runtime carriers, publication carriers, and identity entries;
   verify full identity semantics and allocator-backed create-transition evidence after
   resealing.
   Classify first-create provenance through one shared linear analyzer: original and
   genuinely new roots are parentless, severity-rematerialized roots retaining a
   definition/ownership coordinate record the exact prior canonical same-definition
   root, removed definitions leave terminal history, and reaction children record an
   exact persisted different-definition `apply_definition` producer. Use the same
   generation rule for worsen, treatment, and later recovery, require a unique acyclic
   non-branching ownership-preserving spine, and require every retired generation and
   its reaction closure to be terminal. Full rematerialization exports only new
   application roots as current lineage; old roots remain predecessor/terminal evidence.
   Reconcile the optional wound single-leaf expansion with #1535 by requiring exact
   `apply_definition.maxExpansion = 2` when present, requiring same-domain `replace` for
   a root-bound target, and recording the producing effect in every reaction-created
   identity's first create transition.
   Register the eight closed spiritual consequence profiles in the common effect
   component registry with persistent-afterlife-actor/wound-link scope and a safe generic
   player projection. Their canonical payload remains owner-relative; do not route them
   through `afterlife_combat_condition` or `combatConditions[]`.
5. Add RED common plan/cache/fingerprint/before-image/same-root/scale/replay/rollback
   tests, including cross-plan stage mixing and created-event versus causal-event
   tampering.
6. Extend accepted-mechanics authority, planner, normalizer publication, snapshot
   coverage, and bounded repair. Do not expose player commands yet.
7. Remove loose response/file-mapping/state-distributor wound authority and legacy
   `WoundReference` fallbacks only after replacement tests are GREEN.

Checkpoint: a synthetic accepted wound can create/worsen/heal with exact effects and
history atomically for every owner carrier; effect removal never heals it.

### Phase 2 — Mortal occurrence, diagnosis, treatment, and recovery

1. Add RED signed formal/QTE/combat/trap/check/hazard/narrative occurrence,
   current-snapshot/event-set parity, optional create versus explicit worsen, and GM
   optional/lower/guaranteed/durable-replay tests.
2. Implement Mortal event adapters and complete free-form proposal validation without a
   wound catalog. A shared current-snapshot reader verifies the live manifest, detached
   authority, active request context, required path coverage, and exact signed bytes.
   The production-only `ComposeAcceptedResponse(fs, lease, sourceEvent, gameResponse)`
   ingress treats the closed source-shaped event as correlation only, resolves one
   signed formal/QTE/combat/trap/check/hazard/narrative occurrence, and derives the
   owner/profile/source/outcome/severity and optional explicit create-versus-worsen
   target, plus the exact nullable minimum/guaranteed-trigger authority already supported
   by the opportunity contract. The correlation may repeat the selected ordinal and
   public owner/profile/source/outcome/safe-context fields, but never the hard maximum,
   minimum/guarantee, binding, event coordinates/seals, receipt, transition, anchor, or
   after-image. A shared composer accepts only a closed typed response-
   event projection plus selected typed evidence at exact zero-based ordinals; it derives
   every selected semantic seal itself, preserves the compatible generic-event seal, and
   returns the complete ordered event set plus its fingerprint. It does not accept raw
   JSON or caller-provided fingerprints. The source-result boundary, later adapter, and
   `ValidationService` each build their own projection/evidence from their authoritative
   typed result or signed occurrence. `ValidationService` independently reads both
   occurrence and decision-receipt roots from the signed pre-turn snapshot, verifies
   their agreement and unchanged live bytes, reconstructs the complete event set and
   opportunity from those roots plus the signed wound carrier, and compares the result
   instead of replacing it with the command binding. Exact signed prior receipts are
   then used for command recomposition. The adapter returns
   the existing wound composition result without writing. Formal re-trauma then uses the
   ordinary `StateDistributor` -> `ValidationService` -> common-plan pipeline; callers
   cannot inject or reuse an occurrence, treatment binding, fingerprint, transition,
   receipt, anchor, or after-image. Each typed producer first reduces its accepted result
   to a write-free complete harmful occurrence-candidate batch; harmless results produce
   none. Producers use one sibling of the registered-system-outcome projection seam after
   actual resource/effect finalization; unsupported producer kinds remain unregistered
   and fail closed rather than inferring harm from combatant, hazard, die, or prose JSON.
   The seven names are the closed common language, not a mandate for placeholder
   implementors: a concrete registration arrives only with the owning finalized typed
   resolver. T064 freezes the pure reducer plus signed correlation/validation seam;
   T070 supplies the first reachable production orchestration and remains the sole
   occurrence/receipt publisher.
   The source-result common plan reads both pending occurrences and durable
   decision receipts, resolves exact pending/consumed replay versus changed-source
   conflict by producer operation key, and atomically appends only genuinely new
   candidates in sealed batch-ordinal order; only a subsequent pending-turn
   snapshot that seals its exact bytes may expose the opportunity to the GM. The later
   wound-decision common plan appends the exact opportunity-decision receipt (including
   `none`) and consumes the pending occurrence. While the same active pending-turn
   snapshot is retained, restart replay reconstructs authority from its signed pre-
   consumption occurrence plus the current append-only receipt/pending partition and is
   either an exact no-command result or a conflict; a newer snapshot makes the old
   correlation stale. Both state implementations reuse the length-prefixed
   UTF-8 SHA-256 writer; their exact v1 candidate/occurrence/receipt domain strings,
   field order, derived IDs, and null encoding are frozen in `data-model.md`, so tests
   can detect a reordered or caller-trusted seal independently.
3. Add RED route/discovery/requirement/procedure/course/guaranteed/resource/stale-ref
   tests using two unrelated setting fixtures. Discovery uses an explicit
   `requiresKnownFacts` least-fixed-point graph, sealed success/failure diagnosis
   evidence, and a distinct append-only `author_alternative_treatment` transition.
4. Implement structural treatment/discovery validation separately from fresh exact
   item/resource/skill/provider/facility/location reachability, then compose sealed
   diagnosis/alternative-route authority, reservation, and outcomes.
   The dependency contour is T066 accepted-state/coordinates/course/start/bundle types
   and first-course/non-course factories, then T067-A procedure die/Fate authority and
   immutable shells. The remaining mutually dependent work follows the production-only
   phase graph from research decision R-019: T068-A resource preparation/registry and
   T069-A deterioration-policy authority; T070-A canonical anchor representation plus
   accepted-create common composition; T069-B non-replay recovery scheduling/intents;
   T067-B typed-history continuation, request sealing/resolution/persistence; T068-B
   finalization and durable claim reconstruction; T070-B treatment/recovery/re-entry
   publication; then T069-C durable replay verification. No test-created request,
   resolution, binding, anchor, history row, receipt, claim, or raw authority is used to
   cross a phase boundary.
5. Add RED recovery/deterioration/canonical `world_time.currentTimeInMinutes`/retry/
   death-boundary tests and implement the registered Mortal policy scheduler without a
   parallel seconds or wall-time clock. The GM proposal cannot author canonical anchors:
   accepted create allocates the recovery anchor from the sealed current minute and
   transition ID; a separate condition/deterioration anchor preserves grace across
   recovery ticks. Due/grace boundaries and time jumps use checked elapsed-cadence plus
   next-anchor state, stabilization rebases recovery and clears its satisfied condition
   anchor, while an accepted worsening re-entry allocates a fresh deterioration anchor
   from the exact `worsen` transition without resetting recovery; death remains a lifecycle
   handoff. T070-A first makes the canonical anchor state reachable only through an
   accepted initial-create plan; T069-B then evaluates that real state. T070-B composes
   typed transition intents into the existing accepted-plan authority and publishes the
   durable receipt required by T069-C replay; `CanonicalStateNormalizer` remains the
   only publisher.
6. Replace legacy Mortal rule/example/UI preview shapes and add a complete GM worked
   lifecycle before exposing the Mortal command flow.

Checkpoint: both cross-setting fixtures complete create -> diagnosis success/failure ->
optional alternative-route authoring -> treat/recover -> heal -> History, with exact
rollback and no catalog lookup.

T067 uses one production-owned sealing boundary rather than exposing evidence-record
construction or fingerprint recipes to callers. `MortalWoundTreatmentPlanner` is the
sole producer of `WoundTransitionRequest` values for `diagnose` and
`author_alternative_treatment`: its `CreateDiagnosisTransition` and
`CreateAlternativeTreatmentTransition` factories accept transition coordinates,
the parsed before/proposed-after wounds, and only the already validated external
authority fingerprints. The factories derive the complete-or-empty diagnosis reveal
set, the appended route/path identities, every wound-local before/after/route/path/
result seal, and the typed durable result. Reducer tests consume those factories and
may tamper with the returned request or after-image; they must not instantiate a
concrete evidence record by reflection or implement a test-only hash domain.

`WoundHistoryState` similarly owns `ComputeTransitionResultFingerprint` and immutable
`AppendTransition` operations. Append consumes a validated
`WoundTransitionHistoryIntent`, assigns the next global/per-wound ordinals, preserves
all prior rows byte-for-byte, recomputes the typed result seal, and returns a newly
validated state. Replay probes and already-accepted receipts carry that same typed
result. This is the stable semantic seam for T059/T067; concrete evidence-record and
hash-writer topology remains an implementation detail.

For command round-trip tests, `WoundResponseInputComposer` owns the existing sole
`ComposeAcceptedTransitionCommandRoot(WoundAcceptedTurnBinding,
WoundTransitionRequest, string)` entry point for reducer-produced transition requests.
T067 adds the distinct pure
`ComposeMortalWoundTreatmentCommandRoot(WoundAcceptedTurnBinding,
MortalWoundTreatmentResolution, string)` entry point because a pre-resolution attempt
request cannot supply the selected typed result and overloading the existing name would
break its frozen single-method surface. Both emit the closed safe command only from
planner-sealed authority; `ParseCommandRoot` followed by `RecomposeCommandRoot` must
reproduce that root exactly. Mutation after composition is rejected either by strict
parsing/seal validation or by recomposition, never accepted by trusting caller-supplied
fingerprints. Tests may hand-author malformed shapes for field/path diagnostics, but
only these production composers establish valid sealed command authority.

T070's diagnosis/alternative command codec first needs complete standalone member
validation as specified in
`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-t070-treatment-member-shapes.md`. Shared local
component/graph traversal and reciprocal slot validation are separate from the real
wound severity/owner/policy predicates. Standalone route/path parsing reuses the same
closed readers, nested validators and canonical writers as full wound parsing, without
inventing a wound or substituting a maximum severity. All registered nested complication
and heal-legacy constructors remain supported. A shape-valid draft has no fresh world
authority; full wound legality and current/signed-source authority are still mandatory.

The shared detached traversal must retain bounded-constructor input faults rather than
silently accepting the empty projection of an oversized expansion. Shape-only per-root
budget accounting includes mechanically derived slots even when an optional reciprocal
summary is absent. Existing full complication parsing already requires non-null slot
summaries; mechanical legacies use their separate derived-source graph, not a newly
imposed wound-consequence slot budget. The narrow diagnosis result-cardinality alignment
in `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-t070-diagnosis-result-cardinality.md` also ensures
that accepted diagnosis intents obey the existing closed history result contract before
command work proceeds: empty success is rejected, empty failure and already-known-fact
success remain representable and durable.

The accepted-command wire projection has its own production-owned deterministic
integrity seal, distinct from the factory's private full-request seal. It binds every
represented authority coordinate, recomputed typed result and available accepted-turn
binding plus final scene. Parsing may accept a structurally well-formed draft before
recomposition verifies these seals unconditionally. Alternative full route/path content
is rehashed, including display names. Diagnosis's omitted wound/event/transition fields
are not guessed, hidden in a memory registry, or added to the closed schema. Fresh
publication later reconstructs those coordinates from the real attempt/request and
canonical/signed sources; a recalculable public checksum is not proof of world authority.
Every parsed family must be retained, counted and checked. Until that fresh adapter
exists, both distribution and validation explicitly reject new accepted variants;
nonempty commands may not succeed as empty wound work. Existing opportunity and treat
codecs remain distinct and preserve the existing mixed-family rejection.
The bounded implementation is specified in
`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-t070-accepted-diagnosis-alternative-commands.md`.
The subsequent local GM response and kind-specific safe-repair boundary follows
`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-t070-alternative-treatment-response-repair.md`.
It preserves complete author/decline drafts, rejects raw nonempty authorings at the
pre-write distributor until fresh authority exists, and distinguishes an alternative
public packet from construction semantics. The approved repair contract requires

all producers, strict consumers, documentation/examples and guards in one current-format
cutover, without a tagless compatibility path. Public persisted format
validation cannot rehydrate the private rejected-response authority required by live
retry. A rejected draft must never be staged as an accepted command just to reuse
opportunity-only capture; the fresh transient-request adapter remains mandatory.
